# kion_compliance_standard (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion ComplianceStandard by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_compliance_standard" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the ComplianceStandard to fetch.
